row.Finding: Bambu PPA-CF supports long-term, stable use in humid environments, even underwater. With a moisture absorption rate 66% lower than normal PA6-CF, it maintains its stiffness and thermal properties over time. Whether printing propellers, customizing surfboards, or any other water-resistant application, PPA-CF delivers reliable performance.
